primary.title: Filing income tax return by 31 August? Key schedules to note in ITR-3 and 4 forms — and how to verify them
primary.summary: Taxpayers filing ITR-3 or ITR-4 should carefully review key schedules and reconcile income, turnover, and TDS to avoid common filing errors. Here are the key schedules, documents, and changes to know for AY 2026-27.
